sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: SnapFeed.ai is operated by Stratum Technologies LLC, a limited liability company registered in Wyoming, USA. Mailing address: 30 N Gould St #28330, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: SnapFeed.ai provides AI-powered virtual try-on and related image generation tools (including garment try-on, packshot, and product-to-model workflows). Outputs are machine-generated and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or unsuitable for a particular commercial use. You are solely responsible for reviewing results before publishing or selling them.

sections.title: Eligibility and accounts
sections.body: You must be at least 18 years old (or the age of majority in your jurisdiction) to create an account and purchase credits. Accounts are created via Google sign-in. You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping access to your Google account secure.

sections.title: Credits and payments
sections.body: Generations consume prepaid credits. Credit packs may be purchased through the in-app deposit flow. Payment instructions may include bank/card transfer or other methods we display at checkout. Credits are typically applied after we verify payment (often within about 15 minutes during business hours, but timing may vary). Prices are shown in the selected currency before you confirm a deposit request. Taxes may apply where required by law.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Credits are digital goods. Refunds are handled under our Refund Policy. Consumed credits (used generations) are generally non-refundable except where required by law or when we determine a material service failure occurred.

sections.title: Acceptable use and AI content
sections.body: You may not use the service for illegal, harmful, fraudulent, or infringing purposes. Prohibited uses include: non-consensual intimate imagery; impersonation or deepfakes intended to deceive; child sexual exploitation content; content that violates others’ intellectual property, privacy, or publicity rights; malware; or attempts to disrupt the service. You represent that you have all rights needed in photos and garments you upload (including model releases where required).

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: We own the SnapFeed.ai platform, branding, and software. You retain rights in content you upload. Subject to these Terms and applicable law, you own the outputs you generate for your account, and you grant us a limited license to process uploads and outputs solely to provide, secure, and improve the service (including through subprocessors listed in the Privacy Policy).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {{legalName}} (“Company,” “we,” “us”) collects, uses, and shares personal information when you use {{brand}}.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy requests (access, deletion, correction, or CCPA inquiries), email

sections.title: Controller
sections.body:
Stratum Technologies LLC, registered in Wyoming, USA.
30 N Gould St #28330, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body:
Account data from Google sign-in (email, name, profile photo).
Credit balance, plan, and deposit/payment request records.
Images you upload and images generated by the service.
Guest usage data: a browser fingerprint hash and optional IP address to enforce free limits.
Technical data such as device/browser type, language preference, and basic logs needed for security and reliability.
Support communications you send us.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body:
Provide and operate SnapFeed.ai (accounts, credits, generations, gallery).
Process payments and prevent fraud or abuse.
Provide customer support.
Improve reliability and safety of the service.
Comply with law and enforce our Terms.

sections.title: AI processing and subprocessors
sections.body:
To generate results, we send necessary image/prompt data to subprocessors, which may include:
• Supabase (authentication, database, storage)
• OpenAI (prompt assistance / image-related AI)
• Replicate (image generation models)
• FASHN (virtual try-on processing)
• Hosting providers for our frontend/backend
These providers process data on our instructions to deliver the service.

sections.title: Guest usage
sections.body: If you use the service without signing in, we store a fingerprint hash and may use IP address solely to enforce free generation limits. This guest data is not sold and is not used for advertising profiling.

sections.title: Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: We use essential cookies/local storage for authentication session state, language, consent choice, and guest credit limits. See our Cookie Policy for details. Analytics or advertising cookies will only be used according to your consent choice once enabled.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep account and credit records while your account is active and as needed for legal, tax, and fraud-prevention purposes. Generated gallery images are kept until you delete them or your account is deleted, subject to backup retention windows. Guest fingerprint/IP limit data is retained only as long as needed to enforce abuse controls.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure.

sections.title: Your privacy rights (including CCPA/CPRA)
sections.body:
Depending on your location (including California), you may have rights to:
• Know/access the personal information we hold about you
• Delete personal information
• Correct inaccurate information
• Opt out of “sale” or “sharing” of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising
• Non-discrimination for exercising privacy rights

We do not sell personal information for money. If we use advertising pixels in the future, we will treat relevant sharing as subject to opt-out and honor your Cookie/consent choices and any “Do Not Sell or Share” request sent to our support email.

To exercise rights, email us with the subject “Privacy Request” and enough detail to verify your account (usually the Google email on the account).

sections.title: Children’s privacy
sections.body: SnapFeed.ai is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child provided data, contact us and we will take appropriate steps to delete it.

sections.title: International users
sections.body: We are based in the United States. If you access the service from other countries, your information may be processed in the U.S. and other countries where our providers operate.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The “Last updated” date will change when we do.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.intro: This policy explains how refunds work for prepaid credits on {{brand}}.

sections.title: Digital goods
sections.body: Credits are prepaid digital goods used to run AI generations. Once purchased and applied to your account, they are available for immediate use.

sections.title: Delivery of credits
sections.body: After you submit a deposit request and confirm payment, we review the transfer and apply credits to your account—typically within about 15 minutes during monitoring hours. Delays can occur outside business hours or if payment details are incomplete.

sections.title: When refunds may be granted
sections.body:
We may refund or re-credit when:
• Payment was received but credits were not applied due to our error
• A material service outage prevented use shortly after purchase and credits remain unused
• Required by applicable law

sections.title: When refunds are not available
sections.body:
Refunds are generally not available for:
• Credits already consumed by successful or attempted generations
• Dissatisfaction with subjective AI output quality alone
• Violations of our Terms (including payment abuse)
• Duplicate or mistaken purchases after credits were used

sections.title: Cancellation
sections.body: You can stop using SnapFeed.ai at any time. There is no recurring subscription cancellation for one-time credit packs. Unused credits remain on the account unless refunded under this policy or required by law.

sections.title: Chargebacks
sections.body: Please contact us before filing a payment dispute so we can investigate. Fraudulent chargebacks may result in account suspension.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how {{brand}} uses cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: What we use today
sections.body:
Essential technologies only, including:
• Authentication/session storage (via our auth provider)

• Guest credit limit / fingerprint-related local data

sections.title: Analytics and advertising
sections.body: We may add analytics or Google Ads conversion tags in the future. If we do, we will categorize them as non-essential and use them according to your consent choice (Accept vs Essential only) and this policy.

sections.title: Managing preferences
sections.body: You can clear site data in your browser to reset local storage and consent. You can also revisit this page after clearing data to choose again when the banner reappears.

sections.title: Third-party resources
